mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, phone AS phone, nickname AS nickname, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, account_status AS accountStatus FROM user_account WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id AS userId, phone AS phone, nickname AS nickname, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, account_status AS accountStatus FROM user_account WHERE phone = #{phone}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_account (phone, nickname, avatar_url, account_status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{phone}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, 'NORMAL', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET nickname = #{nickname}, phone = #{phone}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
